title: When uploading multiple files with st.chat_input, the X to remove file is not visually close to its file
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues. - [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue. ### Summary We recently added directory upload to st.chat_input, making it easy to upload many files. When viewing those files above chat input, the X to remove a file is not clearly visually associated to the correct file. It's equidistant from its intended file and neighbor. This is confusing when scrolled in the middle of a file list. ### Reproducible Code Example ```Python import streamlit as st m = st.chat_input("Type a message", accept_file="directory") if m and m["files"]: m["files"] ``` ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Run the app 2. Upload a directory with multiple files to fill the horizontal scroll width ### Expected Behavior The X to remove a file should be visually clearly associated to its file. ### Current Behavior The X to remove a file isn't visually clearly associated to its file. ### Is this a regression? - [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version. ### Debug info - Streamlit version: 1.48.2.dev20250824 - Python version: 3.13 - Operating System: Mac - Browser: Prism ### Additional Information _No response_
